title: Turbofan Engine System
text: Implement first-order representation of turbofan engine with controller, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Initial thrust source}, {Initial thrust}, {Maximum sea-level static thrust} sets the maximum thrust at sea-level, {Fastest engine time constant at sea-level static (sec)} sets the fastest engine time at sea level, {Sea-level static thrust specific fuel consumption} sets the thrust-specific fuel consumption at sea and {Ratio of installed thrust to uninstalled thrust} sets the coefficient representing loss. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English

params.name: Fastest engine time constant at sea-level static (sec)
params.values: Fastest engine time at sea level 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Sea-level static thrust specific fuel consumption
params.values: Thrust-specific fuel consumption at sea level 0.35 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ratio of installed thrust to uninstalled thrust
